title: Annotate the MongoDB tool schemas with data-classification markers
description: Annotate the Zod schemas in src/tools/mongodb/mongodbSchemas.ts (lines 1-107, the file flagged by finding fnd_01M2G2AGNMHKF9PCB4C85A3JQ3) and every mongodb/* tool argsShape it feeds (including find.ts and create/createIndex.ts, which use .passthrough()) with the x-data-classification markers adopted in task 1: filter, projection, document and pipeline fields that can carry client personal or financial data are marked pii and/or financial, internal-only helper parameters are marked internal. Constraints: markers are additive metadata only - do not change zEJSON, .passthrough() or any tool's validation semantics, or agent tool calls against the client-data and order stores could break; keep pnpm test and pnpm build green; merge via a reviewed PR with one approver per sdlc/policy.json codeReview; deploy through the dev -> qa -> prod environments order with rollback to pinned commit aaa72a040db4c32f3d6488d5e28e2892a68e9ee0; make no change during a declared change freeze.
acceptanceCriteria: Every tool schema under src/tools/mongodb, including mongodbSchemas.ts and the mongodb/* tool argsShapes it feeds (find, create, createIndex), carries an x-data-classification marker consistent with the convention from task 1
pnpm test and pnpm build pass in CI with the annotations applied, with no change to zEJSON, .passthrough() or any tool's validation semantics
The annotations merge to main through a reviewed PR (one approver per sdlc/policy.json codeReview) and rule SCH-PII-01 no longer fires on src/tools/mongodb/mongodbSchemas.ts

verificationMethod.description: Re-run /probe-schemas example-co --app mcp-gateway (the workflow that raised the finding); expected result: rule SCH-PII-01 reports no result for src/tools/mongodb/mongodbSchemas.ts and the mongodb/* tool schemas carry data-classification markers

rootCause.description: The tool-schema authoring procedure for mongodb-mcp-server had no classification step, so fields that read the pii and financial client-data and order stores were written as opaque EJSON records
